title: HandoffToProcessTickets
description: Asynchronous invocation payload sent to process-issues when an OpenAI background response has ended: by issues-generated for the webhook event, or by check-stale-jobs to finish a stale job whose response completed.

response_id.description: The OpenAI response ID (for issues-generated, the webhook event's data.id).

event_type.description: The OpenAI webhook event type for how the response ended; only terminal response events are sent, and check-stale-jobs sends only response.completed.
